scope: Decode the LIGHTLIST ACAD_LIGHT owner-dictionary pointer as a reference role, not as a persistent reactor.

schema.field_order: The ACAD_REACTORS app-data group carries a soft pointer to the ACAD_LIGHT entry in the named object dictionary; a following group 330 carries the owner-object pointer.

implementation.behavior: The source-aware DXF parser preserves the complete ACAD_REACTORS app-data group and exposes its first group-330 value through DRW_LightList::getAcLightDictionaryHandle. The first value is removed from reactorHandles; the following owner-object group 330 remains in parentHandle.
implementation.layout: No DRW_LightList data member or virtual method was added; the public accessor does not change object layout.
implementation.limits: This corrects the DXF typed reference role only. It does not establish a physical DWG crosswalk, ACAD_LIGHT dictionary graph closure, LIGHT target resolution, adapter output, or native lighting behavior. The adapter keeps LIGHTLIST output fail-closed.

validation.input: Locally authored in-memory ASCII DXF text; no fixture file was added.
validation.control: The focused selector verifies the ACAD_LIGHT handle, following owner handle, named LIGHT handle/name, absence of a falsely classified reactor, and exact retained app-data group.
validation.result: PASS: all four focused callback selectors passed and the dwg2dxf executable rebuilt.
